The recipe build models the docs body by hand; the capture reads the host page's body rule.
The page's body rule and Fuse's base layer on it, as the browser applies them.
Tailwind's preflight and Fuse's base layer on `<html>`, which the root does not inherit.
Tailwind's preflight, which the capture page loads as the docs host does; its resets drop or read as the zero they set.
Fuse's base layer, which the recipe build modelled only for the border color: box sizing, zero border, margin and padding.
The browser's default style for the element, which the recipe build modelled only for `display`.

The browser's default style sheet centers a `<button>`'s text (`text-align: center`), which the recipe build never modelled. A hugging Button draws the same either way; a Button stretched across its row centers its label, as the browser does.
The shipped `styles.css` writes `shadow-xs`'s color as `#0000000d`, 13/255 alpha, which the browser paints; the recipe build read the source's `rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05)`.
The spinner's animation, which the recipe build never reached on the spinner; it drops, as every animation does.
The shipped `styles.css` writes only `user-select: none`, whose row drops as before; the prefixed copy the source compiles to is not in the build.
